title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2607.08734v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-Training Quantization has become widely used to compress large language models to make them deployable on resource-constrained devices. However, the evaluation of quantization methods mainly uses accuracy and perplexity, which cannot capture the behavioral changes in the quantized variants. In this work, we propose Correctness Agreement, a decision-level metric that can measure the intersection of correct predictions between the base model and its quantized variant. We use this metric across multiple models and quantization bit levels (8-bit to 2-bit), and we find that the base and quantized variants usually have a shift in behavior even when accuracy and perplexity are preserved. In order to explain this effect, we study the effect of quantization on the structure of the attention weights using statistical and distributional measures. translated_title: 等价性幻觉：大型语言模型中量化效应的统计表征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08734v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：训练后量化已被广泛用于压缩大型语言模型，使其能够在资源受限的设备上部署。然而，量化方法的评估主要使用准确度和困惑度，这些指标无法捕捉量化变体中的行为变化。在本工作中，我们提出了正确性一致性（Correctness Agreement），这是一种决策级指标，能够衡量基础模型与其量化变体之间正确预测的交集。我们使用该指标跨多个模型和量化位宽（8位到2位）进行评估，发现即使准确度和困惑度保持不变，基础模型和量化变体通常也存在行为偏移。为了解释这一效应，我们使用统计和分布度量研究了量化对注意力权重结构的影响。结果揭示了低位宽下的断点，并表明查询和键投影是受影响最严重的部分。
tldr: 本文提出一种决策级指标“正确性一致性”，证明量化后即使准确度和困惑度不变，模型行为也会发生偏移，并揭示低位宽下注意力权重中查询和键投影的显著变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a decision-level metric, Correctness Agreement, showing that quantized LLMs exhibit behavioral shifts even when accuracy and perplexity remain unchanged, and reveals significant changes in query and key projections at low bit widths.
